properties.displayName: UAV S23 - Critical Container Service Stop/Kill (telemetry-tap / mavlink-router)
properties.description: UAVServiceAudit_CL에서 핵심 컨테이너 stop/kill 탐지. 실제 컬럼: ActorId(Operator 아님), ContainerName, Action. MITRE: T0881 Service Stop (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let criticalContainers = dynamic(["telemetry-tap","mavlink-router","pgse-stub","auth-stub"]);
UAVServiceAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where ContainerName in (criticalContainers)
| where Action in ('stop', 'kill')
| summarize ActionCount=count(), Actors=make_set(ActorId), FirstEvent=min(TimeGenerated)
    by ContainerName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    ContainerName == 'telemetry-tap', "telemetry-tap_강제중단_탐지맹점생성",
    ContainerName == 'mavlink-router', "mavlink-router_강제중단_C2두절",
    strcat(ContainerName, "_핵심컨테이너_강제중단"))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project FirstEvent, ContainerName, ActionCount, Actors, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by FirstEvent desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S23 - Critical Container Service Stop/Kill (telemetry-tap / mavlink-router) - {{ContainerName}}
